notes: Fictional example case, not a real paper -- demonstrates the gold-case format and lets the benchmark harness run end-to-end before real Claude-curated cases exist. Updated for the v3 native-name taxonomy (extraction/faire_fields.py): fact_type_candidate values are standard-agnostic native names (dna_extraction_kit, target_gene, forward_primer_name/reverse_primer_name, pcr_reaction_volume, annealing_temperature, pcr_cycle_count, sequencing_instrument) rather than FAIRe's own slot spellings (nucl_acid_ext_kit, annealingTemp, pcr_cycles, instrument, ...) -- those FAIRe names now live only as each taxonomy entry's optional faire_hint, never as a fact's own identity. collection_date/sampling_depth are kept as free-choice fallback facts -- neither is in the taxonomy checklist (those two are normally repository-sourced, not text-extracted), demonstrating the prompt's open fallback still works for facts outside the explicit list.
source_text: Water samples were collected on 14 March 2021 at a depth of 5 meters from three stations in the reef lagoon. DNA was extracted using a DNeasy PowerWater kit. The 18S rRNA V4 region was amplified using primers TAReuk454FWD1 and TAReukREV3 in a 25 uL reaction volume with an annealing temperature of 57C for 35 cycles. Sequencing was performed on an Illumina MiSeq platform.
